CreateChat.description_en: Creates a conversation using the SSE protocol. The conversation results are pushed by the server
CreateChat.description_zh: 创建对话，使用SSE协议，对话结果由服务端推送

CreateSession.description_en: Creates a session. Each time a chat is created, previous chats within the same session are included as historical messages
CreateSession.description_zh: 创建Session，每次创建Chat时会带上同一个Session内之前创建的Chat作为历史消息

DeleteSession.description_en: Deletes a session and all associated chats

GetChat.description_en: Retrieves the details of a conversation

GetSession.description_en: Retrieves the details of a session

SearchInfo.description_en: Performs web search and knowledge base search
SearchInfo.description_zh: 进行联网搜索以及知识库搜索
